# The Fox Lab

The Fox Lab at Northern Arizona University develops infectious disease models, outbreak forecasts, and decision-support tools for public health preparedness and response.

## Primary URL

https://www.foxandtheflu.com/

## Key Pages

- Home: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/
- Research: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/research.html
- People: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/people.html
- Lab Culture: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/culture.html
- Publications: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/publications.html
- Lab News: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/news/
- Blog: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/blog/
- Opportunities: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/opportunities.html
- Contact: https://www.foxandtheflu.com/contact.html

## Expertise

- Outbreak forecasting
- Infectious disease modeling
- Respiratory virus forecasting
- Influenza, COVID-19, and RSV modeling
- Forecast hubs
- Ensemble forecasting
- Forecast evaluation
- Epimodulation and model augmentation
- Public health decision support
- Genomic surveillance and sampling design
- Statistical programming in R
- Reproducible analysis workflows
- Quarto reporting and scientific communication

## Consulting And Advising

The Fox Lab may consider selected consulting or technical advising related to outbreak forecasting, infectious disease modeling, forecast evaluation, and public health decision-support tools when the project is a good fit.

Inquiries should be sent to Spencer J. Fox at spencer.fox@nau.edu.

The Fox Lab does not provide medical advice, clinical guidance, or emergency response decisions.
